title: 1957 UFOs head toward Eisenhower's summer White House

tellings.quote: UFO researcher Brad Sparks thoroughly documented a UFO heading towards Eisenhower's summerh home in 1957

plain: In 1957 a UFO is said to have flown toward the summer home of President Dwight Eisenhower. Michels tells this himself, crediting a UFO researcher named Brad Sparks, who he says "thoroughly documented" it. Michels also mentions Chris Mellon, a former Pentagon intelligence official, and records from NORAD, the North American air defense command, and from Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. If true, it would mean an unknown craft headed straight for the president.
